owner_requirements: gb_feedback_1840: diagnose why the v0.0.23 bonus never fires, then preregister v0.0.24 with a lever that is provably exercised in a short smoke run (>= 10% of games producing the event) before the full run; PRs branch from main; nice 19, host CPU <= 85%

gb_feedback_1950: the v0.0.23 miss is an instrumentation bug (bonus path); fix it and add a validity smoke test - 1-2 games must show the bonus firing and >= 90% valid - BEFORE the 48-game run; wait for main CI on 0745289 green
question: Continuing the v0.0.22 policy with a bonus that pays every VALID knockdown (excluding only falls left unresolved by body contact), do the blocked games that failed v0.0.22's hard gate and monotonicity disappear while the primary still beats frozen v0.0.19?
lever: ONE change of training objective relative to v0.0.22: the bonus becomes motor_gate.valid_knocked_down = knocked_down AND the opponent's first loss is NOT attributed 'unresolved'. Base (start) policy: the v0.0.22 final_params - the only policy that produces knockdowns (the v0.0.23 run from v0.0.19 never produced the event). Training opponent (frozen v0.0.19), model, ES settings, reset and ending v2 unchanged.
why_this_lever: cycle-0034: v0.0.22's knockdowns of v0.0.19 are 22/24 attributed 'self' (one hit at ~tick 252, fall 1-2 s later, outside the 0.5 s window) and 2/24 'unresolved'; 'self' falls are valid wins under ending v2 and only 'unresolved' falls are blocked. v0.0.23's 'knockdown'-only bonus therefore never fired. The valid-knockdown bonus pays the valid falls and withholds exactly the blocked ones that failed v0.0.22's validity floors.
classification: solo motor fitness against a frozen opponent (no match outcome in the fitness); diagnostic, not an unassisted boxing result
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN, run as 16 + 32 iterations on one generator (identical to one 48-iteration call) so the @16 checkpoint is kept

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate
gate.note: motor gate vs gen4, reported (not gating)

primary.name: vs frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds 20000-20023 (48 games), checked in order

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.24 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)

order: 1. VALIDITY: valid games (selfplay.valid_result) >= 40/48, else verdict VALIDITY_FAILED (fail loud: non-zero exit, later criteria not evaluated)
2. DECISIVENESS: decisive games (valid wins + valid losses, i.e. not draws) >= 24/48, else verdict DECISIVE_FAILED (fail loud)
3. (b) Hoeffding lower95 > 0 and (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit; else CRITERION_NOT_MET; both pass -> PRIMARY_PASSED

hard_gate_v0013.opponent: frozen v0.0.13 (punch, punch_params(gen4, onset=-3, duration=0, amplitude=2)), eval noise 0.05

monotonicity.pass: for each: valid >= 40/48 first, then Wilson 95% lower bound of the more-trained side's win rate over valid games > 0.55 (same rule as the v0.0.21 addendum)

level_up: tag v0.0.24 iff the smoke gate passed AND primary verdict PRIMARY_PASSED AND hard_gate_v0013 passes AND both monotonicity matchups pass

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline: v0.0.19 self-mirror on the primary seeds
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: candidate vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 21000-21023
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: candidate and v0.0.19 (re-run, checked per trial against its committed summary) vs gen4
secondary_reported_not_gating.training: per-iteration stand time, scoring_share, knockdown_share, valid_knockdown_share
secondary_reported_not_gating.reporting: every head-to-head split by the stronger side's seat with wins / losses / draws / no-contests / blocked / engine faults counted separately
secondary_reported_not_gating.blocked_diagnosis: for every blocked game in the primary, hard gate and monotonicity: count; the per-seat split shows them separately

red_team_notes: the bonus is near-saturated at the base (22/24 valid knockdowns in the cycle-0034 replay), so most learning pressure falls on the remaining blocked trials and on stand time
the training opponent is v0.0.19, while the hard-gate failure is against v0.0.13; fewer blocked falls vs v0.0.19 may not transfer to v0.0.13
valid 'self' falls credit the candidate for an opponent that topples 1-2 s after one hit: valid under ending v2, but causally weak (cycle-0034 caveat)
no game has been played on seeds 19000-22023; the diagnosis replay used 99900-99923; smoke tests use seeds >= 99960
pre_declared_readings: SMOKE_FAILED: the base does not produce the event against v0.0.19 on these seeds; report the census; no full run
hard gate fails with blocked games vs v0.0.13: training against v0.0.19 does not transfer; next lever: add v0.0.13 to the training opponents
VALIDITY_FAILED / DECISIVE_FAILED / CRITERION_NOT_MET on the primary: report seat split and attribution

smoke_gate.when: first stage of the probe, before any training
smoke_gate.policy: the v0.0.22 base policy (group_pd, eval noise 0.05)
smoke_gate.opponent: frozen v0.0.19 (group_pd, eval noise 0.05) - the training opponent

bonus_check.what: motor_gate.trial (the exact path the fitness bonus reads)

validity_check.what: selfplay.play_game head-to-head under ReferenceEndingEnv (0.5 m, anti-stalling, ending v2)

smoke_gate.on_fail: SMOKE_FAILED if either check fails: the probe exits non-zero, no training, no gates; both censuses are saved
